column1: # Seasonal influenza vaccination coverage by age band, Köln (SK Köln, key 5315), seasons 2022/23 to 2025/26.
# Source: RKI KV-Impfsurveillance, claims data of the statutory insurance physicians (statutory insured only), 1 dose;
#   Rieck et al. 2025, "Inanspruchnahme von Routineimpfungen in Deutschland", Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.18197755, file
# coverage_band: percent of ALL persons of the band who are vaccinated in the season; this is the value the model uses.
#   Bands 60-69, 70-79, 80+: the coverage of the group 'Personen ab 60 Jahren'.
#   Bands 18-29 to 50-59: coverage_risk times prevalence_risk (the file gives these ages only for 'Personen mit Grunderkrankung').
# coverage_risk: percent of the persons with an underlying condition who are vaccinated, as in the file.
# prevalence_risk: stratum size of the risk group divided by the number of persons of the band; the number of persons is the
#   agents of population-ages.tsv times the ratio (stratum size of the group 60+) / (agents aged 60 and over) of the season.
# source_season: the season the values are taken from; 2025/26 holds the last season of the file (assumption A42).
# Decision log: docs/influenza-multiseasonal.md, sections 7.5, 7.6; decision D19; assumptions A41 to A43.
